name: gi-category-2-income-tax
description: Prepare Gibraltar Category 2 certificate applications, annual income classification, capped ABS calculations, part-year minimum-tax working papers and the published IT1C filing/payment workflow. Covers individuals and Rule 11 family elections, previous presence and activity tests, permitted Gibraltar work, property income outside the cap, foreign-income exclusions and elections, certificate continuation and surrender. Uses the current June 2026 Rules and application pack, the 2025-26 return and 2026-27 payment dates. Distinguishes the application fee, certificate advance tax, payments on account and actual bank transfer. Announced wealth-policy implementation, cash allocation and named source conflicts remain explicit; this source-cited draft is not professional attestation.
